admissionSteps: Generate a plain search phrase; never use the raw phrase as a final title.
Check an official source for the problem or rule and record its publication/access date.
Search note and BOOTH for the exact reader + moment + failure + artifact combination.
Compare against publication receipts, paid queue, free queue and opportunity map.
Reject if only the wording differs from an existing intent.
Choose one article archetype and define a standalone free completion.
Only then write a natural Japanese title.
